title: Trust, security and privacy - smartphones (2020 onwards)

options.label: Individuals use a smartphone for private purposes (3 months)
Smartphone has some security system, installed automatically or provided with the operating system (3 months)
Smartphone has some security system, installed by somebody or subscribed to it (3 months)
Individuals already lost information, documents, pictures or other kind of data on their smartphone as a result of a virus or other hostile type of programs (3 months)
Individuals at least once restricted or refused access to personal data, when using or installing an app on the smartphone (3 months)
